headline.technical: Wall Street ended lower before Nvidia results (Dow -1.64%, S&P 500 -1.03%), while futures rose after Nvidia earnings, per Morningstar and Yahoo Finance; gold, copper and Brent fell.
headline.layman: US stocks fell yesterday, but futures point higher after Nvidia's results calmed worries about AI. Gold, copper and oil all fell too.

global.title: Futures rise after Nvidia; Wall Street fell on Tuesday

status.technical: S&P 500 closed at 7340.53 (1d -1.03%, 5d -2.40%), VIX 23.92. Morningstar and WSJ said futures rose after Nvidia earnings soothed AI jitters. The dollar index is 103.78 and Brent is 89.94 (1d -3.44%).
status.layman: US stocks fell yesterday. Today's futures are up after Nvidia's results eased AI worries. The dollar is firm and oil fell to 89.94 a barrel.

consequence.technical: If the Fed rate-hike expectations cited by Yahoo Finance and WSJ persist, then a firm dollar and pressure on gold could continue. WSJ says energy-driven cost pressures may keep inflation high into next year.
consequence.layman: If people keep expecting higher US interest rates, the dollar may stay strong and gold may stay under pressure. WSJ says war-related costs could keep prices high into next year.

impact.technical: Per the notes, gold (-2.57% 1d), metals and Indian metal stocks fell on a stronger dollar and rate-hike expectations. Bloomberg reports credit repricing may hit weaker borrowers; ECB flags AI valuations as a risk.
impact.layman: Gold and metal prices fell because of the stronger dollar. Bloomberg says some weaker borrowers may struggle as debt costs more. The ECB warns that AI company prices are a risk.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after S&P 500 falls bigger than 1 standard deviation, the next day rose 48% of 154 times and the next 5 days rose 58% of 153 times. These are base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: In the past, after a drop like this, the S&P 500 rose the next day about 48% of the time and over five days about 58%. That is history, not a prediction.

status.technical: Dow closed at 50759.42 (1d -1.64%) and Nasdaq Composite at 24328.38 (1d -0.74%); Russell 2000 fell -1.50%. Per the Straits Times the Dow fell 859.71 points before Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic debut. Bovespa is -17.34% over 1m.
status.layman: US stocks fell yesterday, the Dow by 1.64%. Brazil's market has dropped a lot over the past month.

consequence.technical: If Nvidia's results keep calming AI fears, as Morningstar's morning briefing framed it, then tech could lead a rebound; Bloomberg and Yahoo Finance say Anthropic's pricing is next.
consequence.layman: If Nvidia's good news keeps AI worries calm, tech shares may recover. Anthropic's share sale is the next event to watch.

impact.technical: Of the largest Dow names, 1 of 6 rose on the day; UnitedHealth fell -5.42% and Microsoft -2.27%. Evidence on other causes is thin in the notes.
impact.layman: Most big Dow companies fell yesterday. The notes give few reasons beyond the AI worry.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after a big one-day fall, Dow next day rose 56% of 162 times and next 5 days rose 55% of 161 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: After days like this, the Dow rose the next day about 56% of the time. That is history, not a forecast.

status.technical: FTSE 100 closed at 10646.90 (1d -0.40%); DAX 0.01%, Euro Stoxx 50 0.16%. Yahoo Finance UK said European shares stabilised after a 1.75% decline as Nvidia results supported tech; Morningstar said FTSE fell as miners slid despite softer CPI.
status.layman: European shares were steady today after a fall, helped by Nvidia's results. London dipped because mining shares dropped.

consequence.technical: If AI-linked tech keeps getting support, then European chip stocks may hold gains. ECB warns AI valuations and fiscal imbalances weigh on financial stability.
consequence.layman: If AI shares stay supported, European chip shares may hold up. The ECB warns that AI prices and government debt are risks.

impact.technical: UBS sees FTSE 100 at 11,500 by end-2027 per Investing.com. Brussels raised eurozone growth forecasts on AI-driven exports per the Financial Times. Evidence on other sectors is thin.
impact.layman: UBS thinks London's main index could reach 11,500 by end-2027. The EU raised its growth forecast for the euro area.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after ordinary days, FTSE 100 next day rose 55% of 866 times and next 5 days rose 57% of 863 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: Historically the FTSE 100 rose the next day about 55% of the time. That is not a prediction.

status.technical: Nikkei 225 closed at 59024.28 (1d 0.28%); KOSPI rose 1.99%; Hang Seng fell -0.91% and is -9.11% YTD; Shenzhen Component is -21.19% YTD. CNBC reported Trump landed in Shenzhen for talks with Xi and Putin. Bloomberg said a China-Korea culture deal lifted K-pop stocks.
status.layman: Japan and Korea rose today, while Hong Kong fell. Trump arrived in China for talks with Xi and Putin.

consequence.technical: If the summit eases trade tension, as Xi's APEC free-trade pitch (Al Jazeera) suggests he hopes, then sentiment could improve; the notes do not say that will happen. A fund firm said Chinese stocks have not yet bottomed (SCMP).
consequence.layman: If the summit goes well, trade worries may ease, but the notes do not promise that. A top fund firm says Chinese stocks may not have hit bottom.

impact.technical: Per Bloomberg, K-pop stocks soared on the Korea-China deal. SCMP says Tencent's capital spending rose more than sixfold, hurting profit. Barclays blamed forced retail liquidation for Taiwan's rout (Bloomberg).
impact.layman: Korean entertainment shares jumped on a deal with China. Tencent's profit fell as it spent much more on AI. Barclays blamed forced selling for Taiwan's drop.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after ordinary days, Nikkei 225 next day rose 53% of 819 times and next 5 days rose 57% of 816 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: In the past the Nikkei rose the next day about 53% of the time. That is history, not a prediction.

status.technical: Morningstar and WSJ reported US futures rose after Nvidia earnings soothed AI jitters; CNBC says shares and neoclouds rallied. WSJ says the results do little to settle questions about the future; Nvidia's Nasdaq-listed shares were -0.44% (1d).
status.layman: Nvidia's results calmed AI worries and futures rose. But WSJ says big questions about Nvidia's future remain.

consequence.technical: If AI sentiment holds, then tech may lead. ECB says AI borrowing has historic parallels with a subprime bubble, so a reversal in sentiment could matter.
consequence.layman: If AI optimism holds, tech shares may rise. The ECB warns that heavy AI borrowing looks like past bubbles.

impact.technical: CNBC says Nvidia's CEO resigned after reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy; Colette Kress is interim CEO. Chip stocks rose in Europe (Morningstar). Evidence on wider effects is thin.
impact.layman: Nvidia has a new interim boss, Colette Kress. European chip shares rose after the results.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after ordinary days, Nasdaq Composite next day rose 55% of 825 times. These are base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: Historically the Nasdaq rose the next day about 55% of the time. That is not a forecast.

status.technical: WSJ says the dollar stayed near a 19-month high on expectations of further Fed rate rises; Yahoo Finance says gold fell below $3,800. Gold closed at 3764.70 (1d -2.57%); DXY 103.78; US 10-year 5.10.
status.layman: The dollar is strong because people expect higher US interest rates. Gold fell below $3,800.

consequence.technical: If Fed hike expectations persist, then a strong dollar may keep pressuring gold and metals, as Business Standard's metals note describes.
consequence.layman: If higher rates stay expected, a strong dollar may keep pushing gold and metals down.

impact.technical: Business Standard says Nifty Metal fell 2% on a stronger USD and higher-rate expectations; Mint says Titan and Kalyan fell up to 5%. Evidence on others is thin.
impact.layman: Indian metal and jewellery shares fell as gold and metals dropped.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after gold falls bigger than 1 standard deviation, next day rose 60% of 149 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: After big gold drops, gold rose the next day about 60% of the time in the past. This is not a prediction.

status.technical: WSJ reported Iran attacked Kuwait and Bahrain after setting a gas tanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent closed at 89.94 (1d -3.44%, 1m -17.33%). Business Standard quotes Kotak Neo that Brent's war premium faded.
status.layman: Iran attacked Kuwait and Bahrain. Even so, oil fell to 89.94 a barrel, down from a month ago.

consequence.technical: WSJ says Middle East supply-chain disruption may keep inflation high into next year even if the war ends. If so, price pressure could persist.
consequence.layman: WSJ says war costs could keep prices high into next year, even if a peace deal comes.

impact.technical: UK inflation accelerated as energy costs stayed high per WSJ; Financial Times says the British energy price cap may exceed £2,000 in January. Evidence for other regions is thin.
impact.layman: UK prices rose faster because of energy costs, and the household energy cap may top £2,000 in January.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after Brent falls bigger than 1 standard deviation, next day rose 49% of 171 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: Historically, after big oil drops, oil rose the next day about 49% of the time. That is not a forecast.

status.technical: CNBC and Bloomberg reported Trump landed in Shenzhen for talks with Xi and Putin; Xi pitched free trade at APEC (Al Jazeera). CNBC says Ukraine's allies rejected US criticism of deep strikes ahead of the meeting.
status.layman: Trump is in China to meet Xi and Putin. Xi says China wants stable trade.

consequence.technical: If talks ease trade friction, sentiment may improve; The Economist, however, says China and Europe are entering a permanent mid-level trade war.
consequence.layman: If talks go well, trade worries may ease. The Economist warns China and Europe face a lasting trade dispute.

impact.technical: Evidence on market effects is thin in the notes; Shenzhen Component is -21.19% YTD.
impact.layman: The notes do not show how markets will react, so the effect is unclear.

outlook.technical: Base rates: after ordinary days, Shenzhen next day rose 49% of 819 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: Chinese shares rose the next day about 49% of the time in the past. That is not a forecast.

status.technical: Bloomberg reported credit chiefs warning of a 'fear factor' as debt reprices; the ECB's Financial Stability Review flags AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geoeconomic tensions. US 10-year yield closed at 5.10.
status.layman: Bloomberg says debt is getting repriced and weaker borrowers may struggle. The ECB lists AI prices and government debt as risks.

consequence.technical: If rates stay elevated, Bloomberg says the repricing is likely to continue and cause a shakeout among weaker borrowers.
consequence.layman: If interest rates stay high, weaker borrowers may face trouble.

impact.technical: ECB says markets should help discipline France over high debt (Reuters). Evidence on other effects is thin.
impact.layman: The ECB says markets should help keep France's debt in check.

outlook.technical: US 10-year: after ordinary days, next 5 days rose 56% of 850 times. Base rates, not predictions.
outlook.layman: Yields rose over the next five days about 56% of the time in the past. This is not a prediction.
